questions.explanation: A punctured neighbourhood consists of all points at positive distance less than $r$ from $x_0$: $0<|x-x_0|<r$ with $r>0$.
questions.source_support: The definition gives $\{x\in\mathbb{R}:0 \lt |x-x_0| \lt r\}$ for some $r \gt 0$.
